facts.value: DE 4 filing status -> DE 44 Method B table: 'Single or Married (with two or more incomes)' -> Table 5 'Single Persons, Dual Income Married or Married with Multiple Employers'; 'Married (one income)' -> Table 6 'Married Persons'; 'Head of Household' -> Table 7 'Unmarried/Head of Household' (annual payroll period; the same three-way order repeats for every payroll period in Tables 8-28). Table 1 (low income exemption) and Table 3 (standard deduction): 'Single or Married (with two or more incomes)' -> column 'Single, Dual Income Married or Married with Multiple Employers'; 'Married (one income)' -> column 'Married' for '0' or '1' allowances, or column 'Married' for '2' or more allowances (allowances on DE 4 or Form W-4); 'Head of Household' -> column 'Unmarried Head of Household'. No DE 4 on file -> Single with zero allowances.
facts.authority: California Employment Development Department (EDD)
facts.note: Table titles in DE 44 Rev. 52 (4-26): PDF p.56 'Annual Payroll Period Tax Rate Tables', Method B Tables 5, 6, 7; PDF p.54 Method B Table 1 and PDF p.55 Method B Table 3 column headings; PDF p.24: no existing withholding certificate -> 'Single with Zero withholding allowance'. DE 4 status wording from DE 4 (Rev. 56 1-26) p.1 'Filing Status' [US-CAS5-015]. Consequence: a married employee who checks 'Single or Married (with two or more incomes)' is withheld on the single table (Table 5), never on Table 6.
